instruction.text: What do you know about birds? Fill in the gaps.

atoms.b: All birds have wings and ((++feathers fur fingers)) which cover their bodies and keep them warm.
Birds also have a ((++beak venom fin)) which is well-suited to their environment. Ducks, for example, have wide, flat beaks. These beaks help them reach ((++plants people cars)) on the river banks.
((++Beaks Fins Tails)) can also be hook-shaped, like that of an eagle. The eagle’s beak is particularly ((++sharp soft shaky)) to help it tear apart its prey.
Most birds can ((++fly burrow swim)). However, some birds, which have adapted to particular habitats, cannot fly. ((++Penguins Pigeons Parrots)), for example, can’t fly, but are talented divers.
All birds lay ((++eggs milk butter)), which eventually hatch into chicks.
